projects.title: Tuition Centre Registration & Scheduling System
projects.summary: Final Year Project built for a real tuition centre client — automates class registration, teacher assignment, and conflict-free scheduling, plus payments and per-class promotions.
projects.description: Developed as a Final Year Project for an actual tuition centre client, replacing their manual, spreadsheet-driven scheduling process. Handles end-to-end registration and booking flow: students book classes, the system auto-assigns and schedules teachers while detecting and preventing timetable conflicts across rooms/teachers/students, processes payments for bookings, and includes a promotions section to advertise each class. Covers the full lifecycle from browsing available classes to confirmed, paid, conflict-free enrollment.

projects.title: Blockchain-Based Marketplace
projects.summary: A final-year exam project — a Web3 marketplace where users connect MetaMask, sign in with their wallet, and list or buy products using ETH.
projects.description: An e-commerce marketplace built on blockchain for a final-year exam. Users authenticate via MetaMask wallet sign-in before they can post a product for sale or buy one. Listings can be added or removed, and every transaction — uploading a product or purchasing one — is settled in ETH, with the resulting blockchain transaction ID and user ID displayed for full transparency and traceability.
